ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, lines \(m\), \(n\), and \(l\) intersect, and \(m \perp n\), \(\angle 1 = 48^\circ\). What is the degree measure of \(\angle 3\)?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since line m intersects with line n,\\
Therefore $\angle 1 = \angle 2 = 48^\circ$,\\
Since m $\perp$ n,\\
Therefore $\angle 2 + \angle 3 = 90^\circ$,\\
Therefore $\angle 3 = 90^\circ - 48^\circ = \boxed{42^\circ}$.
